spans.s:
Ordain,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓvi-DA 3 U, AdiS 6 P, nirdiS, saMvyavasTA c. (sTApayati), pra-pari-kxp c.; pracud 10, vac 2 P, smf 1 P; ‘o(rdain)ed by Sastras’ SAstrokta, SAstravihita-smfta, SAstranirdizwa, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 (aDikAre) niyuj 7 A, 10, aDikf 8 U or c., aBi-zic 6 P, vyA-diS; (religiously) dIkz 1 A, DarmakarmaRi niyuj.
Ⓝ[Ordain]er,Ⓒs.ⒹprakalpakaH, saMsTApakaH, pracodakaH.
Ordeal,Ⓒs.ⒹdivyaM, satyaM, parIkzA, pramARaM; ‘o(rdeal) by fire’ koSaH-zaH, taptadivyaM; ‘subjecting, oneself to o(rdeal)’ divyagrahaRaM; ‘trying o(rdeal)’ (fig.) tattvanikazA Apad.

Order,Ⓒv. t.ⒹAdiS 6 P, nir-ni-samA-vyA-diS, SAs 2 P, A-jYA c. (jYApayati), pracud 10.
Ⓑ
 2 vi-DA 3 U, praRI 1 P, nirvah c.; See Manage.
Ⓑ
 3 parikxp c., krameRa vinyas 4 U or c. or sTA c. (sTApayati) or ni-DA, saMvi-DA, vyavasTA c., vi-, rac 10; [] vyUh 1 U.
Ⓑ
 4 Ordain, q. v.
Ⓔs.ⒹAjYA, A-ni-deSaH, nirdeSaH, SAsanaM, niyogaH; ‘written o(rder)’ AjYApatraM; ‘what are your o(rder)s’ ko niyogo'nuzWIyatAM; ‘your Majestyʼs o(rder)s will be obeyed’ yaTAjYApayati devaH.
Ⓑ
 2 pra-, codanaM-nA, viDiH, niyamaH, viDAnaM, preraRA, vacanaM.
Ⓑ
 3 kramaH, anukramaH, paripAwi-wI f., AnupUrvyaM-rvI, paryAyaH, paraMparA, pAraMparyaM, Avft f.; vyavasTA, vinyAsaH, viracanaM-nA, saMviDAnaM; ‘natural o(rder)’ AnulomyaM; ‘inverted o(rder)’, ‘reverse o(rder)’ prAtilomyaM, vyutkramaH, vyatikramaH, viparyayaH, viparyAsaH, vyatyAsaH, vyatyayaH; ‘o(rder) of battle’ vyUhaH, sEnyaracanA, balavinyAsaH; ‘natural o(rder) of words’ anvayaH; ‘in natural or direct o(rder)’ anulomaM-mataH; ‘in inverted o(rder)’ pratilomaM-mataH; ‘in good o(rder)’ susTita, surakzita, suvihita; ‘in o(rder)’ suvinyasta, suviracita, vyavasTita, krameRa sTApita; (adv.) krameRa, kramaSaH, yaTAkramaM, kramAnurUpaM, anupUrvaSaH, AnupUrvyeRa, paripAwyA; ‘in o(rder) to’ ex. by arTe-rTaM in comp.; by dat. or by inf.; ‘out of o(rder)’ avyavasTita, Bagna-krama, asusTa.
Ⓑ
 4 mArgaH, sTiti f., rIti f., padDati f., AcAraH, niyamaH; ‘not breaking the (established) o(rder)’ sTiteraBettA (R. iii. 27) sTityE daMqayato daMqyAn (R. i. 25) ‘for maintaining o(rder) &c.’; ‘breaking the o(rder)’ sTitiBedaH, atipAtaH, paryayaH, upAtyayaH.
Ⓑ
 5 gaRaH, vargaH, varRaH, jAti f.; ‘the lower o(rder)s’ avara-aDama-varRAH, aMtyavargaH, aDamajAtIyAH.
Ⓑ
 6 ASramaH, varRA-SramaH; ‘head of a religious o(rder)’ ASrama-guruH.
Ⓝ[Order]er,Ⓒs.ⒹAjYApakaH, Adezwf m.; SAstf m.
Ⓝ[Order]less,Ⓒa.ⒹkramahIna, SUnya, akrama, anavasTitaM.
Ⓝ[Order]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹvyavasTita, yaTAkrama, kramAnugata, sakrama, anupUrva.
Ⓔadv.ⒹyaTAkramaM, paryAyeRa, kramaSaH.

Ordinance,Ⓒs.ⒹviDiH, maryAdA, kalpaH, pra-, codanaM-nA, sTiti f., DarmaSAstraviDiH-maryAdA, niyamaH, sUtraM.
Ⓑ
 2 ni-A-deSaH, SAsanaM, niyogaH.

Ordinary,Ⓒa.Ⓓpracalita, prasidDa, prAyika (kI f.), lokaprasidDa.
Ⓑ
 2 sADAraRa (RI f.), sAmAnya, vya(vyA)vahArika-AcArika-nEyamika (kI f.), nitya, yaTAvyavahAra, yaTApadDati; ‘something more than o(rdinary)’ viSezaH.
Ⓑ
 3 sAmAnya, maDyama, prAkfta, avara, nItiviSizwa; ‘an o(rdinary) woman’ nAtirUpa-vatI strI, sAmAnyalAvaRyopetA.
Ⓔs.ⒹDarmADyakzaH.
Ⓑ
 3 sADAraRaBojanasTAnaM.
Ⓝ[Ordinar]ily,Ⓒadv.ⒹsAmAnya-taH, sADAraRataH, prAyaH, prAyeRa, prAyaSaH.

Ordinate,Ⓒa.ⒹyaTAnukrama, anupUrva.
Ⓝ[Ordinat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹviDAnaM, kalpanaM, niyogaH.
Ⓑ
 2 dIkzA; See Ordain.
Ordure,Ⓒs.ⒹpurIzaM, vizWA, uccAraH; See Dung; ‘to void o(rdure)’ purIzaM, utsfj 6 P or uccar 1 P.
